note: Before a noun it changes like *uno*: *un buon caffè*, *un buono studente*, *una buona pizza*, *una buon'idea*.
Before a noun it changes like the article: *bel ragazzo, bello studente, bell'uomo, bei ragazzi, begli amici*.
Can shorten to *gran* before a noun: *un gran giorno*.
Before the noun it can mean *long-standing*: *un vecchio amico* = an old friend.
Before the noun = dear (*caro amico*); after it or with *essere* = expensive (*è caro*).
The colour of the sky, and of Italy's national teams: *gli Azzurri*.
Never changes: *una macchina blu, due macchine blu*.
Often left unchanged in the plural too: *scarpe marrone*.
Never changes: *una rosa rosa*, *dei fiori rosa*.
*bravo in cucina* = a good cook. Also *Bravo!* = Well done!
Nationalities are written with a small letter: *italiano, norvegese*.
Also how Italians answer the phone: *Pronto?*
